headline: Customs-Issued Pistol Traced in Ateneo de Zamboanga School Shooting Probe
seoTitle: Customs-Issued Pistol Traced in Zamboanga School Shooting | FMB News
seoDescription: Authorities say one pistol used in the fatal Ateneo de Zamboanga school shooting was issued by the Bureau of Customs to the suspected shooter's father; the investigation into firearm access continues.
keywords: Bureau of Customs pistol school shooting
deck: Investigators are examining how firearms owned by the suspected shooter's father, including a Bureau of Customs-issued pistol, were accessed and brought onto the school campus.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: A shooting at a school attached to Ateneo de Zamboanga University in Zamboanga City on Tuesday left two people dead: a Grade 10 student and the suspected shooter, who was also a student. Two other people were injured.

Reuters and the Associated Press reported later Tuesday that one pistol carried by the suspected shooter was a government-issued firearm tied to the Bureau of Customs and belonging to the suspect's father, a Customs official. A second recovered firearm was also reported to belong to the father.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Authorities are investigating how the student obtained the firearms and brought them onto the campus. Reuters reported that the father was relieved from his post while the investigation proceeds, while the Associated Press reported that possible administrative liability is being examined.

Officials also confirmed that the attack was livestreamed on social media. FMB News is not republishing violent footage, identifying minors beyond what is necessary to report the event, or treating the suspect's motive as established while forensic and police investigations continue.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The new firearm-tracing information raises questions about custody and safekeeping of government-issued weapons, household firearm access, school security and accountability after a weapon assigned to a public officer was allegedly used in a school attack.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for formal findings from the Philippine National Police and Bureau of Customs on the firearms' chain of custody, any administrative or criminal proceedings, and school-safety measures announced by Ateneo de Zamboanga University and government agencies.
